_note: What `the checks pass` means here. Read by .claude/hooks/_projectchecks.py, which the auto-commit gates on. Each key takes a command string, a list of commands, or false to disable that check as a stated decision. An absent key means detect it.
_why_lint: ruff.toml selects E,F,I,B,S,UP -- the S set is bandit's rules native to ruff, so shell=True is caught without a second tool. Enabling it on 2026-08-03 found four unused imports in shipped hooks. The JSON check is here rather than in a suite because a stray comma in settings.json silently turns the whole hook layer off, which is the worst failure mode in this repo.
_why_no_typecheck: mypy is not installed and this codebase is almost entirely unannotated, so it would report hundreds of findings nobody intends to fix. That is noise, and a noisy gate is one people learn to route around. Revisit if annotations are ever added.
